about: Step 7 plan (Nov 5): every "bring" piece of Mid, sorted in clean/*.json, gathered into modules a player would recognise, each mapped to v100's structure (one Unit shell with settings, ticks, book entries, one effects law, laws with real math), and the builds that move them in, at most 10 permit items each, each with one match test against Mid. Plumbing first, then the economy, the soldiers and fighting, then the extras; each feature's screen comes later as a menu build from a mock-up. Pieces are "book.piece"; a big table split by feature lists its rows as "book.piece.row". Sizes are Mid's bytes from map/PIECES.md (a split table's share by its rows). New laws are numbered QCA on; ones reused keep their Q code.

modules.name: The dice and the slow beats
modules.what: One seeded dice for every roll, so the same game can be played twice and tested, and one clock for the things that think slowly.

books: measure: BEAT (slow, health, Natives) as D entries
laws: none new: QBF the dice (Mulberry32, N65), QAR weighted pick p = w_i / Σw (N49) for roulette, QP settle x(t) = L + (x0 − L) e^(−t/τ) (N16) for relax, QY ΔN = rN(1 − N/K) (N27) for logistic
code: index.html floor "QBF the dice": rnd() and roulette() beside the seed; every Math.random in econ.js, combat.js, ai.js asks it
index.html floor "the door": every(sec) beside the tick

books: measure: the flow window (VEL) as a D entry

laws: none: a running sum
code: econ.js: earn/spend/pay; every write to SIDES[].store in econ.js, combat.js, ai.js goes through them

laws: none: a spatial hash

modules.name: The effects law and a kind's numbers
modules.what: Research changes a number (speed, health, damage, cost, gathering) through one rule, read every time a kind's number is asked for.

ticks: every shell row gets "keys" (its class and kind) that an effect names (fx.k)
books: tech (new book, empty mold): an entry = {at, line, age, cost, time, fx:[{s, k, m|a|min}], need, when, cite}
measure: none new
laws: QCA Effects: stat = (base + Σa) × Πm, a "lowest" effect takes min; speed adds its research shares, applied once to the base (Albert 11:40) (Albert Nov 5 11:16 (3)); a building's health = v100's health × (1 + Σ research share) (11:16 (4)); a kind's health kept in share when its most moves (keepHealth). Source: Mid 08-core.js fxv (design), Albert's calls
code: index.html floor "the door": stat(shell, side, key) the one window every module reads; nothing reads D for a kind's stat directly

measure: none
laws: none: a table look-up
code: combat.js: isFoe() replaces "s.side !== t.side" wherever a target is picked

modules.name: The odds of a battle

books: measure: a tower's worth 120 and a villager's 250 (Mid; D177 holds 100: by the 10:31 rule Mid's)
laws: reuse QAF P = r²/(1 + r²) (Lanchester 1916, N35) with r bent by the counter factor D140 when the striker's kind counters the struck's (Mid matchup); reuse QAH fight with probability V/C (Maynard Smith & Price 1973, N38)
code: combat.js: WAR.strength and odds(a, b) in one home; ai.js and menu.js read it

modules.name: Gathering

laws: reuse QV R = c(1 − δ)/(c/g + 2d/v + w·c/(A·v)) (Holling 1959, Charnov 1976; N23, N24) with d the walked length round water (wayLen), not the straight line
reuse QX g ÷ (1 + others/room) (Fretwell & Lucas 1970, N25)
reuse QW move on only when the new find pays more

laws: QCI Standing spots: n spots on the hex lattice fill a disc R ≈ 0.525·d·√n (hexagonal packing, density π/(2√3)); Mid 13-sim-civil.js
QCJ Separation: two closer than d part along a fixed direction by their ids (Reynolds 1987 separation, Mid's cite)
code: index.html floor "Floor 5, movables": collide() after the steps, one pass over the M3 grid

builds.test: Same seed, same game: Mid's rng(seed) and v100's rnd() give the same 1,000 draws, and unitsNear(x, y, r) returns the same set as a full scan of THINGS on Mid's opening.
Build a Home and scrap it at 10%: stores, the minute's flow and the ledger lines equal Mid's; fmt(1234) reads 1.2k in both.
With Bronze working and Leather armour learned, a spearman's armour, a Home's health share and the odds of 10 spears against 8 archers equal Mid's stats() and chance().
Age up from Stone to Bronze and research Axes then Iron axes: prices, times, the order of the line and a woodcutter's rate equal Mid's.
Ten villagers sent to one bush patch: each stands on its own spot, the crowd share and wood/food gathered in 5 minutes equal Mid's within 2%.
Place a Barracks and drag a 12-piece wall with a gate: the snapped spot, the builders sent, the build time, the gate open to an ally and shut to a foe, and the seal's gap equal Mid's.
One game year with 4 farms, a pasture, 20 villagers and 10 soldiers: food eaten, spoiled, harvested, the soil left and the flock equal Mid's.
A loaded villager and a rider walk 100 m over grass, mud, snow and ice in winter with and without Horseshoes: times equal Mid's, and research never multiplies twice.
Train every kind the Barracks, Range, Stable and Siege workshop offer in each age: kinds, prices, times, speed and the kit drawn equal Mid's.
20 spears charge 20 archers from behind on Mid's seed: blows, who targets whom, routs and survivors equal Mid's fight.
Muster a battalion at the War Council and let it stand at home while a raider comes: squads, ranks, the guard ring, kiting and healing in a tower equal Mid's.
Hold on a soldier, box 8 more, tap a deer, tap a foe: picked set and orders given equal Mid's tapAt/order on the same taps.
Send Alpha to the crosshair, reinforce with Bravo, then shield wall and charge: arrival times, the reinforcement plan and the charge's tiredness equal Mid's.
A raid on the town: villagers leave unsafe finds, Shelter fills the buildings, and when the rival's Town Center falls its stores go to you and the score equals Mid's.
Teach 5 spears into swords, a priest converts, medics heal after a fight, a spy sabotages a mill: costs, times, health and the stall equal Mid's.
Send a small and a large camp wagon and lay caltrops on the road: the camp's pieces, supply, healing, and the trap's toll on a passing column equal Mid's.
Sell 300 wood, buy 200 stone, debase the coin, run a workshop on cloth for 5 minutes: prices, gold and goods equal Mid's.
Two caravans on a route to a trade stop, one guarded, robbers about: pay a run and what is robbed equal Mid's.
Declare war, send an envoy, make a beaten rival a vassal: notice, answers, tribute, levy and loyalty over 10 minutes equal Mid's.
A computer of each personality plays 20 minutes alone on Mid's seed: its goals in order, its army mix and its first attack time equal Mid's.
One year on Mid's seed: the sky's spells, the moon's phase each night, the ruts on the road and a flood equal Mid's.
On Mid's seed with every hazard on: the finds and their guards laid, the events in order with their warnings, a robbers' raid, a hired drifter equal Mid's.
A summer storm over a wooden town, then an outbreak: the buildings that burn, those saved by villagers, the sick and the cured equal Mid's.
A tower at dusk in fog beside a wood: tiles seen and remembered equal Mid's fog grid; the small map marks the same incoming army.
Mid's night scene with a finished building and a glide to the Town Center: the camera's path, the lights' list and the pop's curve equal Mid's frame by frame (pictures side by side for Albert).
A board truce for a year: the hidden age opens, soldiers stand down, the Games' winner and the crowns equal Mid's; a raid out of sight is told at Mid's delay.
Each of the six civs trains its own unit and gets its bonus: the unit's numbers and the bonus applied equal Mid's.
New game, the Silk Road scenario on Mid's seed: the land's character, the home finds, the open ways and the starting stores equal Mid's.
Save mid-battle and on leaving, reload: the waits and every unit, find and building restored equal Mid's save/load round trip; a thrown error costs one frame.
The Guide written from v100's books lists the same entries, numbers and order as Mid's guideModel on the same tables.

order_why: Need first: the dice, the ledger, the grids, the effects law, the foe test and the odds (F10–F12) are read by everything after, so nothing is built twice. Then what makes v100 play like Mid soonest: the ages and research, gathering and building, food, seasons and pace (F13–F17), then the soldiers as one Unit shell with kinds by age, the blow, nerve, squads, picking many, missions and the Director (F18–F22), then the Alarm and winning, the School, priests, spies and prisoners, and the war camp (F23–F25). The extras follow by what they lean on: market before trade, relations before vassals, the computers once they have everything they choose between, finds before events, weather before fire, lights and sight, then the look, peace and mail, the civs, the map, saving (last, so its fields are written once), and the Guide's words. The Throne waits for Albert's description. The menus come last, one build a mock-up, after the features they show work by test hooks.
